state:
**Goal `ext-grants` — a guest reaches only the files and hosts all three parties grant — Stage 2 has not landed.** M9. No floor is carried: the suites, the `.nvst` trees and `nv verify` are the safety net, and goals `ext-host` and `ext-compiler`'s tests stay green as tests of the tree.

The design is ADR 0246 § 7 and the user's, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets. No record slot: a question the record leaves is settled under AGENTS.md's priority ordering and written in the module doc of the file that answers it.

**`wasmtime-wasi` is ruled out** (playbook, *Writing Novis itself*): it pulls `tokio` `rt`, which `rule:concurrency/one-scheduler` and `crates/nvs-runtime/tests/manifest_policy.rs` refuse. The crate was never one of the user's calls, so the choice is settled under the priority ordering: `nvs-ext` generates the WASI host traits with `wasmtime::component::bindgen!` over `wit/nvs-ext/deps/` and implements them itself, with `wasi:io` mapped (`with:`) to `wasmtime-wasi-io` 48, which has no tokio. That buys what Stages 4 and 5 want anyway: the file door is `Core\IO`'s own canonicalise-then-prefix check, and HTTP is `Core\Http\Client`, not a second stack.

A first attempt with `wasmtime-wasi` worked and was reverted; its design carries over. A `pub const LINKED` list in `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs`, one `add_to_linker` per interface after `handle::link` in `Host::new` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:404`), a `pub(crate) wasi` field on `Guest`, and `Loader::imports` admitting a WASI interface only from `LINKED` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:465`). It also had a test that discriminates, proved by deleting one name from `LINKED`: `crates/nvs-ext/tests/wasi.rs` built one probe component per WASI interface in `wit/nvs-ext/` (`Resolve::push_dir`, a `world wN { import <id>; }` each, `wit_component::dummy_module` under a dev-dependency `features = ["dummy-module"]`, `embed_component_metadata`, `ComponentEncoder`). It then called `linker.instantiate_pre` inside `Host::new`'s `imports` closure and required the set that links to equal `LINKED`. wasmtime's linker resolves a `@0.2.12` import against the host's 0.2 definitions.

items.text: **The dependency and the linker, without tokio** — `wasmtime-wasi-io` 48 beside `wasmtime` in the workspace manifest, and confirm with `cargo tree -i tokio` that no new route to `tokio` appears. `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs` runs `bindgen!` over `wit/nvs-ext/deps/` for `cli`, `clocks`, `random` and `filesystem`, maps `wasi:io` to `wasmtime_wasi_io`, and links each interface the world lists except `wasi:http`. The filesystem traits answer every descriptor call with `access` because no preopen exists yet, and `preopens.get-directories` returns an empty list. Then the probe test and the `LINKED`-only load check described in § State, plus `wasi:http/types@0.2.12` in the refused list at `crates/nvs-ext/tests/load.rs:253`. The `Not on disk` paragraph of `docs/rules/packaging/a-guest-has-no-ambient-authority.md` and its `guardedBy` in `data/rules/packaging/a-guest-has-no-ambient-authority.json` gain the new test, then `bun nv rules --render`. `rule:packaging/a-guest-has-no-ambient-authority`.

**An empty context** — no environment and no arguments; stdin empty; stdout and stderr go to the calling request's log at `debug`, with the extension's name as the channel, as `nvs:ext/log` writes (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/log.rs:1`). `nvs-ext` does not link the runtime, so the sink is a trait object the host passes in, beside `Budget` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:90`).

**The request's clock and generator** — the wall clock is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:3537`'s `wall_clock`, so a fixed test clock reaches the guest; random bytes are drawn through `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs:927`'s `draw`, through the same host-passed trait.

**`exit` traps, and a libc-shaped guest runs** — `exit` throws `ExtensionError` and the next call is fresh (`rule:packaging/a-guest-crash-throws`, `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:690`); a WAT component importing what a `wasm32-wasip2` libc links at start-up loads, runs, prints and finds nothing it could use. Tests in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/wasi.rs`.

backlog: **What goal `ext-host` left to the linker** — `nvs:ext/log`, `nvs:ext/settings` and the `[ext.<name>]` block (ADR 0246 § 9) are linked only by tests, never by a host; `crates/nvs-config/src/directive.rs:261` classes `extension`. A file set of its own.
**Stage 4: files** — the generated filesystem traits over preopens from the intersection, through `Core\IO`'s canonicalise-then-prefix door; one test per party, `..` and a planted symlink.

**Stage 5: outbound HTTP** — `wasmtime-wasi-http` is ruled out as well, because it depends on `wasmtime-wasi`. `bindgen!` over `wit/nvs-ext/deps/http.wit`, the outgoing handler routed through `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/http.rs:3834` (`exchanged`); add `wasi:http/*` to `LINKED`, and both rules lose **Not on disk**.
The goal's prose names `wasmtime-wasi` and `wasmtime-wasi-http` in its stages. Edit `docs/agent/goals/ext-grants.md` to the `bindgen!` route when a session next has it open.
